deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'set -eu; mkdir -p storage/framework/{sessions,views,cache,testing} storage/logs bootstrap/cache; chmod -R a+rw storage bootstrap/cache; attempt=1; while ! php artisan db:show --database=mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; do if [ "$attempt" -ge 60 ]; then echo "MySQL did not become reachable after 120 seconds" >&2; php artisan db:show --database=mysql; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for MySQL ($attempt/60)..."; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 2; done; attempt=1; while ! php artisan migrate --force >/tmp/migrate.log 2>&1; do if ! grep -Fq "Connection refused" /tmp/migrate.log; then cat /tmp/migrate.log >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$attempt" -ge 60 ]; then cat /tmp/migrate.log >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "MySQL refused migration connection ($attempt/60); retrying..."; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 2; done; cat /tmp/migrate.log; php artisan db:seed --force; exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=${PORT:-8080}'
